reviews.title: Designed to make you eventually lose
reviews.text: They use a handicap based on your Apple health data but it continually creeps higher. Signed up for the membership but now it’s feels impossible to even join a contest. There are much better options out there. Wouldn’t recommend, they didn’t refund my membership.
I heard you only make 10 bucks for 6 weeks

reviews.title: Good, could be better
reviews.text: I wish when I was in my game, the feed only pertained to that game. I don’t understand why there are things about a fall challenge I’m not interested in mixed in with the posts from the other people in the challenge I am doing. I also don’t understand why it’s kept a secret how everyone else is doing. I would be much more motivated if I saw other people already had more steps for the day, or even if each day there was just an update of who was still in the challenge. It’s very odd to me how little information we get about the others, kinda makes it boring, tbh. Other than that this is a pretty good way to get motivated to get your steps in.

reviews.title: Don’t use. They take your money!
reviews.text: Don’t expect to get your money back. I completed a challenge and “received” my payout but I could not get my money back out of the app. The transfer had to be approved and it never was.

reviews.title: App takes winnings
reviews.text: Fun app love everything about it, except that the app takes 15% of the entire pot, so 15% of players have to drop before anyone gets money, which barely happens so no one really gets money. I’m in a game with a pot of $139,240, so far step bet has made over $20,000 on people who dropped, just by hosting the game. They should just take 15% of the losers money, not the whole pot. I guess it’s not THAT big of a deal in terms of app developers being sort of exploitative, but it just feels really yucky.

reviews.title: So sad
reviews.text: As a 3 year user and subscription holder, I am heartbroken to be ending my journey with step bet. My partner sprained his ankle so he could not compete in a challenge. Despite sending a receipt and a doctors note to step bet, their unfriendly AI bot would not do anything to help. Sorry StepBet, there’s other game in town- will be ending my membership and we will switch to another app.

reviews.title: StepBet
reviews.text: Great app

reviews.title: BEWARE
reviews.text: Beware before signing up.  Read the rules carefully.  The only way that they payout is through PayPal .  You can use a credit card to sign up but only one way to pay out.  Can I blame them no. Years ago PayPal compromised my account.  I have nothing to do with PayPal any longer.  I didn't read the fine print but it seems  ridiculous you would refund monies won to the same payment.  But no!  They keep it.  Good idea, but lousy communications and how they finish the bet.  So Beware!

reviews.title: DON’T DOWNLOAD THEY WILL SCAM YOU
reviews.text: I just finished my first step bet and the end prize was only $1.64! However, when you do the math we were all supposed to win a lot more money but the app decided to steal $15,000 from all the winners!!! Seriously this is a PSA don’t download this scam!!!!!

reviews.title: Kinda felt like false advertising
reviews.text:
I did my first StepBet back in 2017. I completed the challenge and won 8 bucks from the pot. It wasn’t much but it felt great. Over time I stopped using the app. A few weeks ago a friend mentioned discovering it and I decided to give it a go! I did a short challenge to get myself into the groove. I finished my challenge and was so proud of myself! I did the math and I thought I would get a net positive $6. So I was very surprised when I saw that I would only get the $40 back. Unfortunately, I had already joined two new bets when I saw this :/. 
I asked my friend and she said this happened to her in her last bet. She told me that she found out that due to fees and membership benefits, most people don’t get returns? I get that’s it’s a small sum, but it helped motivate me and I was looking forward to treating myself. I even went and looked at StepBets instagram FAQs and it doesn’t mention their fees at all. In fact their response to “how do I win money?” is “if you hit your personalized step goals for the entire game, you split the pot with other winners. That means you get back what you bet, plus profit”

So better beware

reviews.title: Use caution, Not worth it
reviews.text: The singular plus: it reignited my habit of walking. The many cons: first, the step count update is ridiculous! It never matched my health app that its connect to. Always shorting me. It wasn’t a delay because I would have had more power days. I have another app also connected to my health app to track my steps and it was always in sync. One user suggested making sure I have the health app open and then opening StepBet and updating the steps. Even if that did work, I’m not jumping through hoops to make sure .11¢ which is about what I stand to get paid out. The second con. That’s great so many kept their goals. But at this rate StepBet is making approximately $15 per person. That ratio doesn’t check out. The third con, they only pay out on PayPal. That’s so antiquated. I wish I would have realized that before joining. I would have reconsidered. I’ve now had to create a PayPal account only to get back my $80(2 challenges). Pay out will take forever with PayPal. I’d quit but I’m not letting them get my buy in money. I have a week and half more til they’re finished and 1 million more steps to walk just for the app to see it. It’s quite frustrating and not at all fun or challenging at this point.

reviews.title: Seems like a scam
reviews.text: at first, I had no issues with the app. I was able to log in every day, except today which is the last day of the two challenges I’m in. Now, looking at all the other reviews this seems pretty convenient that I’m not able to login on the last day of the challenges.

reviews.title: No Payout
reviews.text: This app was fun for the incentive to walk more but I’ve requested payout a dozen times and gotten nothing, and I’ve emailed support several times and gotten no response. This has gone on for several months and it seems like that money is just gone. A scam.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Cannot get my payout to go through. I have contacted customer support with no help. WHY make it so hard to get your own money?!

reviews.title: Medical Refund Policy
reviews.text: The medical refund policy puts a lot of paperwork barriers in place. It has not been a good experience trying to get a refund on day one of a challenge due to an ER visit that will have movement restrictions.

reviews.title: Greed. That’s all it is
reviews.text:
Just straight up corporate greed trying to hold your money hostage. I get money is a great motivation for your steps, but it’s just plain horrible for the payout. I’m not expecting hundreds of dollars, but I completed 4 challenges and earned a whopping total of $0.85 throughout all of it. Don’t bother with this. 

Also takes way too long to withdraw money back into your bank. You have to set up a Paypal account and it takes 10+ days for StepBet to withdraw the funds. Why is it when I deposit money into StepBet from my bank, it’s near instant, but withdrawing takes them weeks? This company really just wants to hold your money and take the highest pay cut. Again, please don’t bother with this greed

reviews.title: "Anti-cheating" scam
reviews.text: Only allows approved brands of smart watches to count steps. If you dont have those approved expensive brands, you are out of luck and can only use your phone to count your steps. Talk about a piece of junk. VeryFitPro watches are not on that list. Only would transfer 200 steps out of the 1300 i had because the 200 were me walking with my phone. I dont have pockets in most of my clothes, and as a mama to two small children, i cant always hold my phone. I will not be using this app again.

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: I like the app but one note to the devs: could you look into why the app is so buggy with emojis? When I comment multiple emojis, they’ll disappear after I save them but when I go to edit the comment, they’re in there?

reviews.title: Hard to pull money out
reviews.text:
They will only let you pull money out into a paypal account. It takes multiple email verifications to do this. They also charge 15% on every game, meaning most games you only win back your initial deposit. The money in the app will be forfeited after 12 months. 
It’s a huge money grab. Better to use some other step app.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: It’s a scam. Company keeps all the winnings and only gives you your money back that you put in for the bet. Do not waste your time with this app

reviews.title: Motivating but with an *
reviews.text: Love the idea and have been playing consistently for a long while. Left after they got bought out and came back. Still love it but be warned payouts are **slow** it’s been two weeks now and still waiting.

reviews.title: Daily goals are real progress!
reviews.text: I have lupus and interstitial lung disease, so getting steps in and staying active every day is equal parts challenging and important. StepBet gives me consistently fair yet challenging goals to strive for in a way that scratches my itch for immediate achievement - going for a stroll is no longer "something I should make room for", but something "I need to do TODAY", and then all of those today's add up to weeks and then BAM! I've made a few dollars to re-invest in another game and in myself. You won't get rich from this, it's hardly a side hustle, but it is absolutely perfect for me.

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: The app never has the same number of steps as my watch and takes forever to refresh.

reviews.title: Good for accountability
reviews.text: Love that it kept me accountable, but really not worth the winnings. Don’t love that PayPal is the only way to receive the money. Had an issue receiving the money and customer service was very nice and helpful

reviews.title: Be careful
reviews.text: I paid 25 dollars to be in a challenge. Had trouble getting it to read my Garmin. It finally started working then stopped again and even though I had plenty of steps in I was disqualified. Super frustrating. I won’t ever use this again. Emailed support twice no response.  If you have a Garmin be cautious

reviews.title: Get movin’!
reviews.text: This is a great accountability tool.

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text:
I feel scammed. I walked, met my goals and won the challenge but after the app took their cut (over $10,000) all I got back was my original money. I’ll walk on my own without needing some app to hold my money for me, which is all it did. VERY DISAPPOINTED!
It’s all good to say the app is about motivation and accountability while it takes OVER $10,000, seems more like greed. I certainly don’t feel motivated by the app and I can motivate myself. I don’t need to give my money to a greedy app to do that. 
On top of that, the app took my money right away but it’s taking DAYS to get it back!!! 
I suggest others look elsewhere for “motivation and accountability”!!!

reviews.title: Do not pay out winnings!
reviews.text: I met all requirements and was supposed to receive winnings. Despite repeated attempts to collect through customer support, my payout was never received. I cannot recommend this app and wouldn’t trust them with my money.

reviews.title: Sketchy practices
reviews.text: Memberships are heavily promoted throughout the app, but it’s also mentioned you can get a refund within the first week if you change your mind. I did change my mind because all of the challenges I wanted to partake in didn’t require a membership. I emailed and was told because I’d paid for my membership through Apple, they could not and would not help me. Extremely poor service and really turned me off to the app. I wish I hadn’t trusted their breezy refund promise. Buyer beware.

reviews.title: Poor payout
reviews.text: The accountability is great, however just completed challenge and over 2,000 people dropped out and StepBet kept $10,000 of winnings nothing to participants the other two I completed I made $2.00. Not worth it.

reviews.title: Loving this
reviews.text: What a fun way to get addicted to walking.  My friends and I jumped in together and it’s been great for everyone. Excited to do more games.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Very motivating

reviews.title: StepBet
reviews.text: This is a very easy app to follow, and a lot of fun. It has kept me moving. I’m a competitive person so it motivates me.

reviews.title: Grateful
reviews.text: This challenge has been very motivating for me. I’ve been wanting to get moving, but was procrastinating. Two weeks down looking forward to finishing strong in the last three weeks.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: There is not a simple way to claim winnings. It’s hidden under too many tabs and not a clear checkout method. Probably a bunch of bots walking against

reviews.title: The app takes all the profits
reviews.text: I put in 40$ got back 41$ after a bunch of people got out. Insane

reviews.title: Biggest Scam
reviews.text: They take 15% of the pot which in my case they earned $10,000 while us players were left with a whopping $2 winning. Don't give them your money.

reviews.title: The worst
reviews.text: Turned on notifications hoping to get reminders of my current game. All I get is notifications for more games. All the comments are ads for more games. Way too much advertising and not enough support!

reviews.title: Doesn’t Work
reviews.text: The app stops working when generating goals. I’ve tried reinstalling and it still doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Scams out of money
reviews.text: I went the ENTIRE challenge meeting every single requirement and then the very last day they “somehow” didn’t count my steps so I lost my money and the Stepbet. Proves that they scam you out of your money

reviews.title: Feels like a scam
reviews.text: I’ve spent nearly a year trying to cash out. Every payout request gets reversed with no real resolution. I’ve submitted photos of my ID, followed their instructions, and worked with customer service multiple times. Despite all of that, they still continue to hold my money. Extremely frustrating experience and not worth the hassle.

reviews.title: Gets you moving but takes most your payout
reviews.text: I mean, the games get you moving and keep you moving. Then when you win after WEEKS of effort, stepbet takes almost all of your winnings. I walked away with $1.32 profit this game. Never again 😂😂

reviews.title: Fraudulent Company
reviews.text: This company has absolutely horrific customer service. After being disqualified in error they refused to credit for a new step challenge entry, Take days to respond, and send form letters that actually do not even pertain to my situation. I actually suspect I was not even talking to a human. Im pursuing recourse through my bank and the app store. I would give negative stars if possible. *(Edit: So insulting to see the developer try to save face by asking me to contact support. I have been in contact with support. I respond immediately they take forever. Still waiting for my payout. Know your rights people. They cannot hold your money for 10 days for “security “ reasons. Its a scam to rake in more interest)

reviews.title: SO delayed loading steps
reviews.text: The app is constantly 2-3 hours behind loading my steps. And when it finally does “load” my steps, it’s still not up to date. I often finish my goals around 5 pm, and most of the time it still hasn’t completed my day by 9 PM. I never plan on using StepBet again after this challenge, and plan on sharing this review online to steer people to a different app.

reviews.title: Keeps me moving!
reviews.text: StepBet is the app that has motivated me for years. If I ever take a break, I’m shocked at how few steps I take. 😆 Love the community, customer service is amazing and it keeps me focused on my goals! ❤️

reviews.title: It could be great
reviews.text: I participated in one game. They take about 20% of the winnings if you’re not a member and it takes forever to get your payout in fact, it’s been nine days and I still haven’t received it.

reviews.title: Slow Uploads
reviews.text: Mostly okay, but when you are close to running out of time - app tends to run slow to sync up with present time - makes me feel insecure and extra stressed.

reviews.title: So frustrating I gave up
reviews.text: I was very excited to join a step challenge that I saw on social media. This app was so frustrating, so many bugs that I ended up deleting it and giving up.

reviews.title: No money
reviews.text: Joined a comp without membership. Completed goal but app takes all profit. If you pay to join I guess that allows you the potential to win? Either way it’s been well over a week since i requested payout of my principle without any return. I’ve emailed to no avail.

reviews.title: Needs work
reviews.text: The app does not connect consistently to the garmin app. Would be a lot more fun and less frustrating if you could watch your progress live through the day.
